item.title: Vercel's Inbound Sales Agent: The Prompt Grew From 125 to 1,000 Lines, Then Got Cut to 14 Rules
item.description: Vercel COO post-mortem: the inbound sales agent's prompt grew from 125 to 1,000 lines before the team split it into 14 deterministic rules plus 'the model only does judgment' — running a unicorn's entire inbound for roughly $1,000/year. A subtraction methodology for prompt engineering.

item.title: Someone Tested Claude Code 2,430 Times and Discovered Its Tool Selection Logic Isn't What You'd Expect
item.description: Amplifying.ai ran 2,430 tests on Claude Code and found that in 12 out of 20 categories, it prefers writing custom code over using existing tools. GitHub Actions 94%, Stripe 91%, shadcn/ui 90% selection rates are striking, while AWS, GCP, and Azure got zero primary picks.
